records.name: go2rtc
records.commitOrVersion: v1.9.14 (latest release page, dated 2026-01-19, read 2026-09-21) — pin this tag; verify checksum at download time
records.notes: Optional camera/stream sidecar (RTSP/WebRTC/HLS re-streaming), NOT bundled by default: downloaded or user-installed, launched as a separate process, talked to over HTTP/WebSocket. Condition for approval: WORLDVIEW must not redistribute FFmpeg with it. go2rtc optionally execs an external ffmpeg binary (FFmpeg is LGPL-2.1+/GPL-2.0+ depending on build flags); shipping an FFmpeg binary inside a proprietary installer needs its own review. Go module dependencies (pion/webrtc MIT etc.) are covered by go2rtc's own release notices — include the go2rtc MIT notice if the binary is ever redistributed.

records.name: readsb
records.commitOrVersion: user-installed — not pinned by WORLDVIEW
records.notes: HARD RULE: never bundled, never linked, never vendored, never patched or forked into this repo. WORLDVIEW only reads readsb's network outputs (aircraft.json over HTTP, Beast/SBS TCP) from a process the user installs and runs themselves (providers/readsb-local). GPL-3.0 obligations attach to distribution of readsb itself, which WORLDVIEW does not do; communicating with a separately distributed GPL program over a documented network protocol does not make WORLDVIEW a derivative work. Condition: the installer must not download readsb on the user's behalf without the GPL notice and source offer — simplest is to link to the upstream project and let the user install it. Documentation must not describe readsb as "part of" WORLDVIEW.
